subject: Identify theta values at intersection points on trace plots

messages.author: dccc61a7b28e0ec4
messages.subject: Identify theta values at intersection points on trace plots
parts: In regards to item trace plots produced via the function itemplot(mod, 1, type='trace'), is there a function in the mirt package, or other method, that would provide the values of theta where the category response trace lines intersect? Thanks in advance for the help!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Identify theta values at intersection points on trace plots
parts:
I don't believe so, though this is largely implied by the classical IRT parameterization difficulty parameters when you use coef(mod, IRTpars=TRUE). For models that don't have a nice transformation though it is possible to locate these crossing locations numerically using some root-solving functions. Do you have a particular example that you're working with?

Phil
